shortDescription: Get facts about DNS records in a zone in UltraDNS

options.name: owner
options.description: Filter records by owner name (partial match). Applies to all RRSet types.

options.name: reverse
options.description: If true, returns records in descending order.

options.name: sys_generated
options.description: If true, includes system-generated status information in the response. This does not filter to show only system-generated records; it adds an indicator to all records. When enabled, each RRSet will include a 'systemGenerated' array that indicates if each rdata entry was system-generated.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Filter records by TTL (exact match). Only valid for RECORDS RRSet type; ignored for others.

options.name: value
options.description: Filter records by rdata value (partial match). Only valid for RECORDS RRSet type; ignored for others.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone for which to retrieve records.
